metadata.script_content:
"""Convert one UTF-8 text document and print the output path."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source = Path(sys.argv[1])
output_dir = Path(sys.argv[2])
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output = output_dir / (source.stem + ".txt")
output.write_text(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
print(output)
metadata.iteration_stdout_binding: stdout of each invocation is the converted_artifact_path corresponding to the document_path used in that invocation

constraints: 打包时必须采用下方“参考步骤”的命令，并将转换产物路径列表传给 --paths。

metadata.script_content:
"""Build the explicitly requested ZIP from supplied output paths."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--paths", nargs="+", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
with ZipFile(args.output, "w") as archive:
    for filename in args.paths:
        path = Path(filename)
        archive.write(path, arcname=path.name)
metadata.command_template: python scripts/package.py --paths <转换产物路径列表> --output bundle.zip
